entities.summary: Claudia Inés Burkart is an Argentine field hockey player who won the bronze medal with the national team at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens and at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing. Claudia has also won two World Cups, four Champions Trophy, two gold medals at the Pan American Games and two Pan American Cups.
